serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
#Britannia.Hands.Flip
Britannia: What do you want, creepy loser? I already have a boyfriend. Get lost.
#Britannia.Hands.Normal
You: O-Oh no, I’m not hitting on you. I’m a friend of your father. 
#Britannia.Face.Smug
Britannia: My father’s? Are you kidding me? Gross⛤~! 
#Britannia.Face.Normal
Britannia: Does that smelly old man want something from me?
You: Smelly old man… 
Is this really how a daughter should be talking about her father? 
It’s not like she’s wrong, but still…
You: The truth is he saw you on the street not so long ago and he wondered if you were avoiding him.
#Britannia.Eyes.Closed+Britannia.Mouth.Normal
Britannia: Eh… I guess the cat’s out of the bag.
Britannia: Of course I am avoiding him, are you kidding me?!
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: That man is disgusting! Both on the outside and on the inside! Did you see how he treats people? 
You: W-Well, I can’t say you are wrong, but he’s still your father!
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Normal
Britannia: I know, right? That’s why he’s still sending me money for college even though I dropped out years ago! LOL
Like father, like daughter. No, she might be even worse! She’s the devil!
Britannia: Listen, I don’t care if daddy is butthurt. He can stop sending money if he wants. I’m already rich and famous!
You: Come on. I know that he’s awful, but he’s still your father. He still calls you his ‘Little Angel’
#Britannia.Eyes.Normal+Britannia.Mouth.Angry
Britannia: Ugh! Thanks for reminding me of that. 
#Britannia.Eyes.Irritated+Britannia.Mouth.Normal
Britannia: Listen, I don’t know what this is about, but you can give up! There’s no way I’m gonna forget about all the awful things he did and act all chummy with him!
She’s not exactly wrong. Her father is a terrible human being…
But still! He works hard to provide for her daughter! 
I don’t want to give up, but there’s no way I can convince her to love her father. 
Maybe if I can at least bring them together their relationship could heal!
Is it even possible? If what she’s saying is true and she’s rich and famous, she can no longer be bought with money. 
Maybe the island would be enough to entice her? 
But is it alright? Wouldn’t it be too cruel for the Landlord? His daughter would be with him only for her gain.
